d: Bharat se qarib sat hazar mil dur ek aisa desh hai jise mini indiya bhi kahte hain. iska nam hai fiji. vaise to ye desh sundar samudri tat aur lagzari risorts ke lie jana jata hai. lekin ek bimari is desh men mahamari banti ja rahi hai. svasthy adhikari chetavni de rahe hain ki fiji men echaaaeevi-eds tezi se phail raha hai. ye akela duniya ka aisa desh nahin hai, jahan echaaaeevi-eds apne pair pasar raha hai. sanyukt rashtr ki ejensi yuen-eds ne aagah kiya hai ki eshiya aur prashant mahasagar ke kuchh deshon men echaaaeevi inphekshan ke nae mamle tezi se barh rahe hain. aise men sal 2030…
